phase_exposure: elapsed wall time since phase start, including earlier 20-sample windows; matched input refresh before every step
controls: same selected program throughout each phase; fresh search per process; no concurrent GPU jobs/builds; no changes to clocks or power limits
limitations: Not independent cold starts at each duration; search and compilation already exercise the GPU. Two process replicates; within-window samples are not independent processes. Final outputs and gradients checked; intermediate windows use the same unchanged program and inputs.
